brief:
Couples in Gaza are holding weddings in tents and improvised venues despite ongoing hardship, according to Al Jazeera English. The ceremonies proceed with limited resources and constrained logistics, with families organizing celebrations without knowing what conditions tomorrow will bring. Weddings have become deliberate acts of commitment in the face of instability.

Residents continue observing matrimonial traditions even as displacement and uncertainty shape daily existence. Couples choose to marry and rebuild, affirming personal bonds and cultural continuity. The practice reflects how Palestinians in Gaza maintain family and social rituals despite the broader constraints surrounding them and their ability to plan for the future.
dek: In Gaza, weddings have become acts of defiance. Couples marry in tents and rebuild, choosing love despite suffering.
title: Gazans marry in tents despite uncertainty and displacement
